info.title: ZennoLab Platfrom 8 Profiles API Documentation
info.description: A comprehensive set of instructions and recommendations to help you successfully use our automatic ZennoBrowser product and get the most out of its features.

get.summary: Retrieves the list of profile folders available in the specified workspace.
get.description: This method retrieves a list of folders available in the specified workspace. Optionally, it is possible to limit the number of results, specify filters, or define sorting conditions. If no parameters are specified, the method returns the first page of profile folders in the default order.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first folder (zero-based).

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of folders to retrieve.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique folder identifier (optional filter).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Folder name (optional filter).

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Sorting condition: Id, Name, FolderType, Quantity (optional).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Folder location: "Local" or "Cloud". Defaults to null.

post.summary: Creates a new profile folder in the specified workspace.
post.description: This method creates a profile folder. The caller must ensure that the specified workspace ID and location are valid.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the profile folder. Cannot be null or empty.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: ID of the workspace where the profile folder will be created. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Folder location: "Local" or "Cloud". Defaults to "Local".

put.summary: Updates the name of the specified profile folder.
put.description: This method can be used to update the profile folder name.

parameters.name: profileFolderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile folder to update.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The new name for the profile folder.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The identifier of the workspace associated with the profile folder. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

delete.description: This method is used for deleting a profile folder. The profileFolderId value must match the existing folder in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileFolderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile folder to delete.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The identifier of the workspace containing the profile folder. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

delete.summary: Deletes the specified profile folder together with all its profiles.
delete.description: This method deletes a profile folder and all profiles it contains. The profileFolderId value must match the existing folder in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileFolderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile folder to delete.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The identifier of the workspace containing the profile folder. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

get.summary: Retrieves accessible browser profiles with optional filters and sorting.
get.description: This method retrieves a list of profiles with their attributes from the specified workspace and the folder. It is possible to optionally filter results by ID, name, tags, and sorting.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first profile to retrieve.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Folder identifier for filtering (optional).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Profile identifier for filtering (optional).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Profile name for filtering (optional).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags for filtering (optional). Multiple tags can be separated by spaces.

parameters.name: tagOperator
parameters.description: Specifies the logical operator for tag filtering: "or" returns profiles with at least one matching tag, "and" returns profiles with all specified tags. Defaults to "or".

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Sorting parameters (optional). Id, ContainerId, Name, CreationTime, User.Sex, User.Name, User.Surname, User.Age, User.Country, OperationSystem.Name, OperationSystem.Version, Brand.Name, Brand.Version, Proxy, Proxy.Name, ProfileState.DisplayStatus, ProfileState.Description, Status, OperationalState.OperationStatus, OperationalState.CanChangeOperationStatus, UsedTime, LastStartTime, LastErrorMessage, Tags, Tags.Id, Notes.

post.summary: Creates a new browser profile in the specified workspace and folder.
post.description: This method creates a new browser profile in the specified workspace and the folder. It is possible to customize various parameters such as screen size, hardware emulation, language, timezone, proxy, and others. All parameters are optional if another is not specified.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The profile name.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Folder identifier (optional).

parameters.name: cpu
parameters.description: CPU configuration settings. The allowed values are: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value or integer number to set custom processor core count (auto, ignore, or number of cores ("2/4", "4/8", "6/12", "8/16", "10/20", "12/24", "14/28", "16/32", "32/64", "64/128"))

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: Memory configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" — use the value from the fingerprint, "ignore" — use the system value, or an integer to specify a custom memory size (auto, ignore, or memory size ("2", "4", "8", "16", "32", "64", "128"))

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Browser language settings. The allowed values are: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value or language locale value (auto, ignore, or locale: Russian - ru English (United States) - en-US German - de French - fr Spanish - es English (United Kingdom) - en-GB)

parameters.name: geoLocation
parameters.description: Geographic location settings. The allowed values are: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value. It is also possible to specify from one to seven floating point numbers that represent the following geo coordinates: Latitude, Longitude, Altitude, Accuracy, AltitudeAccuracy, Heading, Speed, Radius. Some coordinates can be skipped. For example, the following value sequence is valid: 10, , 40, , 60, 70 - means Latitude = 10, Longitude = random, Altitude = 40, Accuracy = random, AltitudeAccuracy = 60, Heading = 70, Speed = random, Radius = random (auto, ignore or coordinates (latitude, longitude, etc.))

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: Time zone settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "system" to use system value, or custom timezone value (e.g., Europe/Moscow).

parameters.name: webGl
parameters.description: WebGL configuration settings. Allowed values: "auto" to use value from fingerprint, "ignore" to use system value.

parameters.name: webGpu
parameters.description: WebGPU configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: webRtc
parameters.description: WebRTC configuration settings. Allowed values: "Emulate" to use value from fingerprint, "Real" to use system value, or "Hide" to disable.

parameters.name: domRect
parameters.description: DOM Rectangle configuration settings. Allowed values: "Ignore" to disable or "Noise" to use dom rect noising.

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Audio configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: fonts
parameters.description: Font configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: battery
parameters.description: Battery configuration settings. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: plugins
parameters.description: Browser plugins configuration. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: proxyServerId
parameters.description: Proxy server identifier (optional).

parameters.name: speechVoices
parameters.description: Speech voices configuration. Allowed values: "on" to enable or "off" to disable.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Additional notes for the profile.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Profile tags separated by spaces (optional).

parameters.name: canvas
parameters.description: Canvas settings. The allowed values are: Ignore to disable this feature or Noise to use noising.

parameters.name: mediaDevices
parameters.description:
Media devices settings.
            The allowed values are: auto to use value from fingerprint, ignore to use real values or custom location values.
            You can specify from one to three integer numbers that represent the following values:
            AudioInput, AudioOutput and VideoInput
            The numbers can be skipped.
            For example, the following values are valid:
            1,,5 - means AudioInput = 1, AudioOutput = random, VideoInput = 5

parameters.name: commandLineArguments
parameters.description: Custom command line arguments to pass to the browser on startup

parameters.name: presetId
parameters.description: Optional preset identifier used to initialize the profile configuration.

parameters.name: osVersion
parameters.description: OS version for fingerprint selection. Allowed values: "win10" or "win11". If empty, the server auto-detects the host OS.

post.summary: Imports cookies into the specified profile.
post.description: This method allows importing cookies into an existing profile in JSON format. Ensure that the cookies parameter is a valid JSON value representing the cookies to be imported.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the target profile for cookie import (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Cookies in JSON format to import.

post.summary: Exports cookies associated with a specified profile.
post.description: This method allows exporting cookies from an existing profile in JSON format.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile from which to export cookies (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

post.summary: Copies cookies from source profile to target profile.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the profile from which to export cookies.

parameters.name: targetProfileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the profile into which the cookies will be imported.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The identifier of the workspace. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Browser Profile

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the profile to retrieve

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The identifier of the workspace. Defaults to -1 if not specified.

post.summary: Recovers a browser profile that is in an invalid state
post.description: This method can be used to recover a browser profile that is in an invalid state in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile to recover (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

post.summary: Forces unlock of a cloud browser profile that is currently locked by another machine
post.description: This method can be used to force unlock a cloud browser profile that is currently locked by another machine in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile to force unlock (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

post.description: This method can be used to clean up cached data for a browser profile in the specified workspace.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile to cleanup (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

post.summary: Moves multiple browser profiles to a target folder.
post.description: This method moves one or more browser profiles to the specified target folder within the workspace.

parameters.name: targetFolderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the target folder to move profiles to.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Array of profile IDs to move.

post.summary: Updates the preset for multiple browser profiles.
post.description: This method updates the preset configuration for one or more browser profiles at once.

parameters.name: presetId
parameters.description: The preset identifier to apply. Use null to remove the preset from profiles.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Array of profile IDs to update.

post.summary: Updates the proxy configuration for multiple browser profiles.
post.description: This method updates the proxy settings for one or more browser profiles at once. You can either set a specific proxy server or assign proxies from a container.

parameters.name: proxyServerId
parameters.description: The proxy server identifier to apply. Use null to remove the proxy from profiles.

parameters.name: proxyContainerId
parameters.description: The proxy container identifier to assign proxies from.

parameters.name: maxProfilesPerProxy
parameters.description: Maximum number of profiles per proxy when using proxy container.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Array of profile IDs to update.

post.summary: Updates tags for multiple browser profiles.
post.description: This method updates the tags for one or more browser profiles at once.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to apply, separated by spaces. Use null to remove all tags.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Array of profile IDs to update.

post.summary: Runs cookie robot for specified browser profiles.
post.description: This method starts the cookie robot for the specified browser profiles. The robot opens each profile's browser and visits the provided URLs to collect cookies.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: List of URLs for the cookie robot to visit.

parameters.name: shuffleUrls
parameters.description: Whether to shuffle the list of URLs before visiting.

parameters.name: loadImages
parameters.description: Whether to load images while visiting pages.

parameters.name: minVisitTimeSeconds
parameters.description: Minimum time in seconds to spend on each URL.

parameters.name: maxVisitTimeSeconds
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to spend on each URL.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Array of profile IDs to run the cookie robot for.

post.summary: Retrieves per-profile status of a previously started script run.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

requestBody.description: Identifier of the run to query, as returned by RunCookieRobot.
